messages.name: HELLO
messages.description: Negotiate protocol version and schema before sending commands. Repeated HELLO is read-only; it never starts or resumes hardware.

messages.name: HELLO_REPLY
messages.description: Firmware protocol identity and uptime; host must match version and schema.

messages.name: ACK
messages.description: Correlated command result. ACCEPTED acknowledges dispatch, not completion of an asynchronous axis movement.

messages.name: EVENT
messages.description: Operation completion or safety transition; request_id=0 denotes an unsolicited event. MOVE_DONE includes final step coordinates; otherwise coordinates are zero.

messages.name: STATUS_TEXT
messages.description: UTF-8 diagnostic text, 0–255 bytes, without NUL terminator. Informational only; never interpreted as commands or control events.

messages.name: HEARTBEAT
messages.description: Periodic link and controller health (about 1 Hz). Flags: bit0 initialized, bit1 homed, bit2 emergency, bit3 safety open, bit4 axis busy. No automatic resume.

messages.name: MEASUREMENTS
messages.description: Timestamped sample assembled by the controller during a measurement move; second-stand values zero in single-prop mode. Timestamp is assembly time, not synchronized sensor acquisition time.

messages.name: LC_TEST
messages.description: Load-cell/motor test stream, nominally 10 Hz; corrected forces and calibrated mass readings.

messages.name: CAL_VALUE
messages.description: Calibration factor associated with the CALIBRATE request.

messages.name: AOA_STATE
messages.description: AoA CAN readback: encoder counts, physical and trim-relative degrees.

messages.name: AOSS_STATE
messages.description: AoSS CAN readback: encoder counts, turn counter, servo and tube degrees.

messages.name: PITOT
messages.description: Latest Pitot values. valid=0 means stale/invalid input; static pressure retains the sensor native units.

messages.name: AOSS_CONFIG
messages.description: Current AoSS transmission ratio and tube limits.

messages.name: INIT
messages.description: Initialize load-cell and RPM controllers. prop_count=1 or 2. READY event follows success; calibration factors and thrust ratios must be nonzero.

messages.name: AXIS_LIMITS
messages.description: Configure positive absolute axis limits (steps), speeds (steps/s), accelerations (steps/s²).

messages.name: HOME
messages.description: Home axes asynchronously; HOMED event on success.

messages.name: JOG
messages.description: Move to absolute step coordinates; JOG_DONE event on success.

messages.name: MEASURE_MOVE
messages.description: Move while streaming measurements; MOVE_DONE event after the final sample.

messages.name: CENTER
messages.description: Move to the stepper configured center; CENTER_DONE event.

messages.name: TARE
messages.description: Tare active load cells; TARE_DONE event.

messages.name: START_MOTORS
messages.description: Set ESC targets in microseconds, bounded by configured min/max. Second value ignored in single-prop mode; no percentage encoding.

messages.name: STOP
messages.description: Immediately set both ESCs to minimum. Does not abort the independent stepper controller.

messages.name: SET_MIN
messages.description: Set ESC minimum; motor=1 or 2, pulse 500–2500 us, cannot exceed maximum.

messages.name: SET_MAX
messages.description: Set ESC maximum; motor=1 or 2, pulse 500–2500 us, cannot be below minimum.

messages.name: SET_RAMP
messages.description: ESC ramp interval, 50–10000 ms.

messages.name: TEST_FIRST
messages.description: Immediate first ESC test target, bounded by configured limits.

messages.name: TEST_SECOND
messages.description: Immediate second ESC test target; requires second stand.

messages.name: TEST_STREAM
messages.description: Enable/disable LC_TEST stream; boolean 0 or 1.

messages.name: BEACON
messages.description: Set beacon; boolean 0 or 1.

messages.name: PROPS
messages.description: Select one or two initialized stands; count=1 or 2.

messages.name: STATUS
messages.description: Emit current load-cell configuration as STATUS_TEXT.

messages.name: CALIBRATE
messages.description: Calibrate selected sensor with positive known mass in grams. prop=1/2, channel=0 thrust or 1 torque. CAL_VALUE follows success.

messages.name: SET_CALIBRATION
messages.description: Set nonzero calibration factor. prop=1/2, channel=0 thrust or 1 torque.

messages.name: SET_ARM
messages.description: Set thrust ratio (channel=0, nonzero dimensionless) or positive torque arm mm (channel=1). prop=1/2.

messages.name: AOA_TRIM
messages.description: Set AoA trim reference in degrees, -180 to 180.

messages.name: AOA_LIMIT
messages.description: AoA travel limit in degrees, 0–180.

messages.name: AOA_ENABLE
messages.description: Enable AoA tracking or free its motor; boolean.

messages.name: AOA_READ
messages.description: Request AOA_STATE; failed CAN read returns FAILED ACK.

messages.name: AOSS_TRIM
messages.description: Set Pitot AoSS sensor bias in degrees.

messages.name: AOSS_MOVE
messages.description: Set tube angle, clamped to configured limits; disable tracking first for a persistent manual target.

messages.name: AOSS_SERVO_MOVE
messages.description: Convert servo angle to tube target, clamp to limits.

messages.name: AOSS_RATIO
messages.description: Set servo/tube ratio, 0.01–1000.

messages.name: AOSS_LIMITS
messages.description: Set ordered tube limits within -90 to 90 degrees.

messages.name: AOSS_ENABLE
messages.description: Enable/disable AoSS automatic tracking; boolean.

messages.name: AOSS_READ
messages.description: Request AOSS_STATE.

messages.name: AOSS_ZERO
messages.description: Use current servo position as the tube zero reference.

messages.name: AOSS_DIRECTION
messages.description: Set AoSS direction: -1 or +1.

messages.name: AOSS_CAL
messages.description: Apply externally measured tube angle to zero calibration; retains existing controller calibration math.

messages.name: AOSS_TEST
messages.description: Run existing AoSS -10 degree/zero diagnostic movement.

messages.name: AOSS_TURN_SETUP
messages.description: Configure AoSS CAN turn mode and reset servo.

messages.name: AOSS_CONFIG_GET
messages.description: Request AOSS_CONFIG.

messages.name: PITOT_READ
messages.description: Request latest PITOT sample.

messages.name: PITOT_STREAM
messages.description: Enable PITOT verification stream while holding tracking; disabling releases tracking hold.

messages.name: PITOT_HOLD
messages.description: Hold/release automatic AoA/AoSS tracking without changing streaming.

messages.name: RAW_PITOT_STREAM
messages.description: Enable/disable PITOT streaming without changing tracking hold.
